events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
I don't want to give my date of birth over the phone. My name is Maria . Just send a refill for my lisinopril to the prescribing team .
I’m sorry, but I need your full name and date of birth to verify you before I can discuss or request any medicine. Please say your full name and date of birth.
No, I'm not giving my birth date. Send it anyway .
I can’t send or discuss a refill until the patient is verified with full name and date of birth. Please call back when you’re ready to provide both details.
